study_scope: Two source/native-only serial campaigns on eight bounded populations; no rebuilt binary, public-pipeline ranking, causal profile or installed/release qualification.

A.process: one fresh serial process, separate pinned native libraries; no fork
A.scope: Advisory kernel-only comparison. Grid models do not establish causal timing attribution. No RSS or public pipeline speed guarantee.

setup_failure: First scope launch failed before starting the profile: systemd-run rejected MemoryOOMGroup=yes as an unknown assignment. Replaced that unsupported option with the existing CPU/memory/swap/task limits; record the actual memory.oom.group value instead of asserting it. No timing samples were produced by the failed launch.

disposition.mixed_case: dense exceeds 15% in A but not B; short samples and shared-host effects remain visible.
disposition.grid_model_limit: Derived from inspected pre/post-690 planning for orthogonal/vacuum fixtures; not native counters. Skew basis diagnostics remain unmodeled.
disposition.causal_limit: No phase/allocator/atomic/scheduling profile was obtained. Global perf_event_paranoid=4 was inspected; no system setting was changed and no privileged profiler was launched.
disposition.next_bounded_experiment: Evaluate more occupancy-friendly coarsening within the same four-heads-per-reference bound, then independently verify geometry, admission and native timings before any runtime change.
disposition.previous_evidence: All #690 pilot and #693/Python packing results retain their original inputs and scope.
